issues.title: Ambiguous rollback mechanism for streaming ingest
issues.why: AC-12 and AC-76 mandate 'atomic rollback' of partial inserts during a chunked/streaming ingest failure, but the spec uses SQLite which does not support nested transactions or long-lived transactions across multiple HTTP chunks easily without locking the DB for other users.
issues.fix: Specify use of a temporary 'IngestBuffer' table or a specific transaction-per-request lifecycle with 'BEGIN IMMEDIATE' at the start of the first chunk.

issues.title: Missing NDJSON Frame Examples
issues.why: While AC-68 defines frame ordering and AC-76 defines error codes, there are no verbatim examples of the 'StreamHeader' or 'StreamFooter' JSON objects in the provided context, forcing the coder to guess the exact key casing and structure.
issues.fix: Add a fenced code block in §97 or §04 showing a sample 3-frame NDJSON ingest sequence.

issues.title: AC-70 Verification Gap
issues.why: AC-70 requires detecting client disconnect within 2000ms, but does not specify the PHP mechanism (e.g., connection_aborted() check) to achieve this in a standard WordPress environment.
issues.fix: Add a 'Verifies' clause or implementation note to AC-70 mentioning the use of 'connection_aborted()' during the flush loop.
